taramandal.intro: Taramandal is not Navtara. Each nakshatra is held by one or more constellation groups; planets in a group take on that mandal's cosmic work.
taramandal.unmapped: Not yet mapped to a complete Taramandal in the current teaching set.
taramandal.emptyChart: No complete mandal currently holds Moon, Lagna, or a core planet in this chart's taught memberships.
taramandal.taughtLead: {count} taught mandals · each nakshatra is held like a king's member of a constellation group.
taramandal.notNavtaraBody: Navtara counts nine tara steps from the birth star. Taramandal is a different system: fixed constellation groups that hold every nakshatra as a member. When planets fall in a mandal, their signification shifts with that group's cosmic energy — including patterns sometimes mistaken for stelliums.
taramandal.coverageBody: Remaining gaps are only the forthcoming Mrityu Karma / Gyan mandals (kings recorded; full groups pending). Partial members elsewhere still count.
